desc:
Can you really call this a city?

Third person shooter, exploration and survival horror game. Quite hardcore sometimes and requires lots of trial and error
Game is FAR from complete...

H to💤
Hold TAB to open inventory, Drag and drop items together "merge" them or whatnot, right click on items for more options,
Backquote ( ` ) to unequip your tool
hold R on tools

Click on enemies to lock onto them and shoot them
Press Q to cancel shooting enemies
(Controls will be put else where in the future... v__V)

HEAVILY inspired by isle, a game made by Badorkbee on ROBLOX..
((ALSO INSPIRED BY TARKOV.))
